title: F. C. Melton — blacksmith
text:
F. C. MELTON.

The farmers all know where to go to get good blacksmithing, for F. C. Melton is tried and true, his work is first class and his long years of experience add much to his responsibility. He is also a splendid wood workman, can make as fine wagon as anybody outside of a regular factory. Because of these facts, he never lacks for work, but has about all he can do. He owns his shop and home, hence his expenses are not great and his prices for work are reasonable.
notes: Business profile/advertisement feature from The Elk publication.
